thesis_line: The database is the thesis, not a default — authorization lives in the database, not the UI.

context_bar.primary_database: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL (Serverless v2 — RLS · pgvector)
context_bar.ai: Amazon Bedrock — Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Titan embeddings

components.label: Next.js on Vercel
components.what_it_does: Serves marketing and the authenticated app; server actions perform every write.
components.why_this_choice: One deployable removes a network hop from every mutation and keeps auth in one place.

components.label: Data access layer
components.what_it_is: The only path from application code to tenant data.
components.what_it_does: Opens an RLS-scoped transaction and sets the session user before any query runs.
components.why_this_choice: A single chokepoint is auditable; scattered queries are not.

components.label: Aurora PostgreSQL
components.what_it_does: Stores the care record and enforces row-level security on every read and write.
components.why_this_choice: The authorization model is per-row and relational; the database can enforce it, the UI cannot.

flows.title: Recording a medication dose
steps: A caregiver submits the dose form; the server action re-checks the session.
The DAL opens a transaction and sets app.current_user_id.
The dose row and its audit row commit together, or neither commits.

entities.name: care_circle
entities.purpose: The tenant. Everything else hangs off it.

entities.name: membership
entities.purpose: Who belongs to a circle, and in what role.

entities.name: audit_log
entities.purpose: Append-only record of every state-changing action.

policies.rule: a row is visible only when its circle is in the caller's membership set
INSERT is permitted; there is no UPDATE or DELETE policy, so neither can succeed

invariants.statement: Every authenticated page lives under the (app) route group, whose layout runs requireSession() on the server.
All tenant data access goes through withAuthedDb(), which runs inside an RLS-scoped transaction.

design_system.personality: Calm, warm, human, dignified. Quiet confidence.
